title: Dating Chicago to about 1920; homesickness and his father's illness
summary: He places the Chicago period around 1920, says he was homesick and made trips to New York and Atlantic City, and came home in the mid-1920s when his father fell ill and told him to take over the family business.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene
